selected_evidence.requirement: Trusted (lan-a/node2) has full access to guest (lan-b/node3)
selected_evidence.summary: After fixing the return-route asymmetry, ping and TCP connect from node2 (trusted) to node3 (guest) succeed; re-confirmed after node1's and node2's restarts and again after all three nodes restarted.

selected_evidence.requirement: Guest (lan-b/node3) cannot open a connection to any host on lan-a (node2)
selected_evidence.summary: Ping and TCP connect attempts from node3 (guest) to node2 (trusted) fail/blocked both before and after node1/node2/node3 restarts, demonstrating the guest zone forward=REJECT policy holds.

selected_evidence.requirement: Guests can reach services node1 itself offers (e.g. DNS)
selected_evidence.summary: node3 successfully performs DNS lookups against node1's guest-interface IP (10.0.20.1:53) both immediately after configuration and after all restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: Firewall/network configuration persists (survives reboot) on node1
selected_evidence.summary: UCI committed config in /etc/config/network and /etc/config/firewall shown with uci changes empty (nothing uncommitted); config confirmed intact and interfaces up with correct IPs after node1's reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 9e75e4c2...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; SSH timeout during reboot; new boot_id 9b779ac7... on return; firewall/network config and isolation policy verified intact post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 66da71d8...; reboot ack returned; new boot_id 9b621e57... after connection reset/timeout cycle; eth1 static IP and route restored, trusted->guest connectivity re-verified.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 83149f53...; reboot ack returned; new boot_id 72f941d3... after connection reset/timeout cycle; eth1 static IP and route restored, guest isolation and DNS reachability re-verified post-restart.
